smart.intro: The contract runs as a smart contract: both parties sign the same document and rule set, and whenever evidence, an approval or a dispute arrives the system re-evaluates every milestone with exactly those rules. The final decision still goes through an authorised person.

engine.title: How it is executed

engine.note: Both digests are recorded with every evaluation, so anyone with the same data can re-run and verify the decision.
engine.verifyHint: The bundle holds the input, the decisions and the seal of each decision. Anyone can re-check them with the independent verifier (tools/verify_decision.py) without trusting the system.

notices.MISSING_DUE_DATE: {{milestones}} have no due date and are on hold. Add the agreed dates with an amendment.
notices.SIGNED_AFTER_START: The contract was fully signed {{days}} days after its start date. Check the schedule; amend it if needed.

amendments.intro: An amendment adjusts the schedule of a signed contract: the buyer proposes new due dates for milestones whose payment is not decided and/or a new end date, the supplier accepts or rejects. The signed terms stay as they are; only an accepted amendment takes effect, and lateness is recomputed from the new dates.

acceptConfirm.title: Accept {{code}}?
acceptConfirm.body: Due dates and the end date change as proposed; the milestones are evaluated again, so lateness and penalties may change. This cannot be undone.

form.title: Propose amendment {{code}}
form.notice: Change only what both parties agreed. New dates keep the milestone order and stay within the contract period; a milestone whose payment is decided keeps its date.
form.endDateHint: In force: {{date}}. Leave it unless the contract is extended.

liquidation.intro: Liquidation is the last step: once every milestone is paid or rejected, the buyer makes the liquidation record with the figures the system settled, and the supplier confirms or rejects it. A liquidated contract is closed for good.
liquidation.title: Liquidation record
liquidation.unaccounted: Paid + penalties + rejected differ from the contract value: check before confirming

acceptConfirm.title: Confirm the liquidation?
acceptConfirm.body: Once liquidated, the contract is closed for good: no more documents, approvals, disputes, amendments or payments. This cannot be undone.

liquidation.proposeNotice: The settled figures (paid, penalties, rejected) are computed by the system from the milestones; the supplier checks and confirms them.
liquidation.waitingOfficer: Every milestone is settled; waiting for the buyer to make the liquidation record.
liquidation.notYet: Not yet: some milestones are neither paid nor rejected.
